text: APPROVE: The three extracted iterators run in the same order as the original blocks (templates, then objects, then animate) and are fully consumed by `AddRange`, so output and line numbers are unchanged. The remaining method has only two top-level `if`s, which should bring it well under 15. I could not build it, so the new parameter types (`Func<Family,bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary`, `IReadOnlySet`) are assumed to match what the callers pass.
